name: 沉水双列旗柱大殿
geometry_authorship: New image-specific longitudinal open hall with six freestanding pillars, patterned green banners, raised axial causeway, two basins and tall rear arch. No earlier room geometry copied; QA harness reuse only.
preview_banner_limitation: Lodestone preview shows green cloth but not the yellow banner patterns. Native decoder confirms eight patterned block entities; no actual client-world visual certification.

neighbor_shape_and_fragile_survival.scope: Vanilla 1.20.1 canSurvive and six-direction updateShape for vines, waterlogged roots/slabs, fences, chain, lilies and pots using in-memory LevelAccessor. Scheduled fluid ticks are counted and suppressed, not executed. No world, random/fluid ticks, propagation scheduler, gameplay or deployment.

water_and_support_boundary.reason_for_two_components: Continuous raised central causeway divides west/east basins intentionally.
water_and_support_boundary.scope: Static boundary and support checks; fluid/random ticks NOT_RUN.

repetition_screen.scope: Available local nature-group NBT snapshot only; normalized interior solid occupancy is a coarse signal, not proof of visual originality. No old file is used as a build input.

deviations_and_import_constraints: 37x23x49 estimated from visible block proportions, not prompt nominal 21x15.
Longitudinal axis is Z: tall northern arched exit, lower southern entry boundary and two lateral ports at Z30.
Two rows of three freestanding pillars retained; open roof intentional.
One narrow waterlogged side connector at Z30 added for dry side-port accessibility; no basin-wide dry platform.
Vanilla green banners carry yellow border and flower/lozenge patterns as approximation; no custom textures.
Biome water tint, fog and external swamp forest not reproduced.
Single vanilla NBT. Size Z49 exceeds default structure-block save limit48: do not resave truncated. Use StructureTemplate import with full-volume occupied-space rejection.
gate: S4-05 and later NOT_AUTHORIZED; do not start or pre-generate.
